recommendations.title: DEV only: inspect synthetic member fixture
recommendations.summary: This is a development exercise, not a recommendation to enable tenant accounts.
technicalSteps: Review the synthetic fixture and expected disabled member count.
Change only the test fixture to exercise PASS and FAIL.
recommendations.impact: No tenant change. Never enable a real account based on this development control.
validation: Run the deterministic evaluator and verify the expected evidence counters.

recommendations.title: DEV only: inspect synthetic invitation fixture
recommendations.summary: This example demonstrates evidence and risk; it is not a guest removal policy.
technicalSteps: Review the synthetic pending invitation count.
Change the test fixture or choose the alternate synthetic pack.
recommendations.impact: No tenant change. Do not remove or reinvite real users based on this example.
validation: Verify PASS, FAIL, NOT_APPLICABLE and UNKNOWN fixtures without network access.

recommendations.title: DEV only: demonstrate manual review workflow
recommendations.summary: A human must assess the synthetic review exercise; the engine cannot assert compliance.
technicalSteps: Read the synthetic control definition.
Record the manual conclusion outside this development test if required by the test protocol.
recommendations.impact: No tenant change and no automated PASS or FAIL.
validation: Verify the control remains MANUAL in HTML and both CSV files.
